At the Lunar Lutetium base, the combat
research team Glory Star was
conducting evaluation tests on the
Earth Federation's next mass-produced
unit, the Bargora． Star ３, newly
assigned, felt doubts about her
mission due to Titan's slander, but
was encouraged by chief Denzel and
others． An AEUG MS unit attacked the
base to seize the Bargora． Forced to
sortie, Glory Star was caught in a
space distortion during battle．

When Glory Star came to, they were in
an unknown colony, Armory One． For
self-defense, they fought the defense
force． Meanwhile, intruders stole a
new mobile suit． With Shin in Impulse
and Alex, Orb's representative's
bodyguard, they chased the intruders,
who escaped the colony． Minerva's
captain Talia ordered the ship to
launch and told Shin to take in the
surrendered Glory Star．

The Minerva pursued intruder Bogy One,
but struggled against Commander Neo's
trap． Alex's quick thinking saved
them, but then, from a spatial
distortion, AEUG and Titans forces
appeared． Amid the confused battle,
Glory Star sided with AEUG and the
unknown ZAFT． The battle ended in
AEUG／ZAFT's victory, but a new
distortion swallowed Glory Star．
Durandal sought contact with AEUG to
grasp the situation．

Transported to another world,
Grendizer and the Vega Fleet faced
off． Glory Star joined the decisive
battle． They cornered Emperor Vega,
but an unknown alien weapon appeared,
letting him escape． After repelling
the aliens, the Earth Federation
surrounded them as Unknowns． To avoid
trouble, they obeyed the military．

The group faced harsh interrogation at
a Federation base, judged as enemy
PLANT agents． They told their story
to Blue Fixer's Tsukikage and
Quinshtain, who seemed sympathetic．
Meanwhile, aliens appeared in Suruga
Bay． Shouhei, following his
grandfather Hyoe's orders, sortied in
Zambo Ace to intercept． Duke Fried
and others joined, but the Federation
sought to restrain them． They fled to
the excavated ship, Bial I．

Amid reports of Unknowns, a party
hosted by the mysterious magnate
Sandman was held in Tokyo． He
announced Earth was targeted by new
invaders, Zerabia． As he said, Tokyo
came under attack． Shouhei and the
others intercepted． In battle,
Sandman's Earth Gult trump card,
Gravion, appeared． Sandman displayed
Gravion's power and declared his
support for Duke Fried and the group．

Shouhei slipped out of Saint-Germain
to greet his father Gengoro returning
from fishing． But in his hometown,
Katsuki and others, from
misunderstanding and prejudice,
demanded the Jin family be cast out．
Aliens attacked again, but Shouhei,
angered by the townsfolk's
selfishness, refused to fight．
Instead, Toshiya in Kukirai-Oh, with
cousins Uchuta and Keiko, took on the
invaders． Encouraged by Gengoro,
Shouhei resolved to fight, completing
Zambot ３'s combination． Victorious,
they headed to space to stop Junius
Seven's fall．

The Minerva and Argama rushed to stop
Junius Seven． Amid poor coordination,
the culprits were revealed as
Coordinator dissidents． To sway
public opinion, Phantom Pain let it
fall, aided by the Titans, and aliens
further plunged the battlefield into
chaos． King Bial joined, and the
fragmentation began． But a distortion
swallowed Glory Star． A huge shard of
Junius Seven was about to crash to
Earth．

Glory Star warps to a South American
elevator． Kei and Olson repel raiders
with its help． Facing new
reinforcements, Kei self-destructs it
with a quake bomb． A mystery figure
shoots down Denzel． The bomb ends the
world．

Beater Service meets Garrod, flung
from Ameria, at a bazaar． Breakers
raid for his Gundam； Za Heat and
Garrod repel them． Gain saves them
mid-fight, then hires them as
partners．

With Gain, the group takes on the
Exodus of Ulgusk． Gainer, an ordinary
boy, is arrested by Sibe Rail on
suspicion of Exodus ties． Gain
infiltrates and saves him． They seize
the lord's Overman and take his
daughter Ana hostage． Repelling Sibe
Rail, they begin an unheard-of
city-wide Exodus．

Gainer resented being pulled into
Exodus and took it out on his idol
Sara． Gain and the others fought
Sibirsk as it pursued Yapan's
ceiling． Sibirsk hired Zola's
Breakers, the Hola family, as
mercenaries, and used them as decoys
while Yassaba closed in． Gainer
staked his pride, challenging Yassaba
and unleashing King Gainer's Over
Skill． The Heat's Ferry brought Iron
Gear as backup, and they repelled
Sibirsk． Afterward, Gainer joined
Exodus to repay Gain．

Seeking revenge on those who
humiliated him, Yassaba infiltrated
Yapan's ceiling． Adette was also
there to rescue Ana, but Gain caught
her． Yassaba burst in, throwing the
ceiling into chaos． Seizing the
moment, Kezinan tried to take over
Sibirsk, recruiting Hola and
attacking． In the confusion, Yassaba
escaped with the fortune-teller girl
Efa, vowing to stop Exodus． The
battle ended in his defeat, and bereft
of all, he joined Exodus with Efa．

Beater Service searches for Cielo
Beater, lost to a warp． A new warp
brings Gekkostate and the Toshu
Federation chasing them． Za Heat
offers a ceasefire, but meddling
forces a fight anyway． Another warp
then swallows Gekkostate and Iron
Gear alike．

Thrown from Gallia to North America by
a distortion, the group took refuge
with local boy Loran． Loran was a
Moonrace, living secretly on Earth for
two years as a sample returnee． As
the Moonrace return began, a
misunderstanding led the Dianna
Counter to attack． Loran fought back
in the White Doll, a mobile suit that
emerged from a statue at the
coming-of-age ceremony． Iron Gear's
crew assisted, repelling the Dianna
Counter． Lord Guen, negotiating with
the Moonrace, prepared his next move．

As a bargaining chip in negotiations,
Guen hired Iron Gear's crew as
bodyguards． From Enil's contact,
Garrod learned Tifa was captured by
the Frost brothers and held in this
city． During the Moonrace welcome
party, Garrod rescued Tifa． Loran
saved him from the Frosts． Amid the
chaos, Dianna Counter joined, aiming
to weaken Earth forces． The battle
ended when Loran confessed his
Moonrace identity and Diana appeared
in his support．

In a lark, Diana and Kihal swapped
places． The group heading to a joint
exercise with the Moonrace was shocked
by the sight． Investigating, Jiron
and the others met Apollo and his
friends, pursued by mysterious girls．
Then the enemy Dushantens appeared．
As Aquarion, the trump card,
struggled, Apollo, enraged at Baron's
abduction, was guided into it． They
won thanks to Apollo, but Toutenshi
was already planning his next move．

Sirius and the others learn their town
was warped to another world． The
Shadow Angels attack again； Iron Gear
meets them with Aquarion． Apollo
beats Cherubim troops sent by Zushi,
who presses him to recall a past
life． Their contact stirs a rift, and
far off, a quake bomb ends the world．

The bomb that ended one world starts
a new one． Emaan's Factory finds Kei
is a Singularity and protects him．
Chiram tries to seize him too, but
Gloma repels them． A mystery weapon
appears； Kei drives it off with
Phantom Pain, then learns from Shaya
a new world was born．

A series of strange murders in the
memory-wiped Paradigm City． Dorothy
and the others searched for the
missing Roger, encountering incidents
wherever they went． Finally, the
culprit R．D． appeared, and escaped
Beck's gang caused chaos, until Roger
summoned Big O． Schwartz, attacking
in the mystic Megadeus, left cryptic
words and departed． Roger decided to
leave Paradigm City in search of
truth．

Bored with his ordinary life in
Bellforest, Renton met the mysterious
girl Eureka． As the new Federation
and Gekkostate clashed over her,
Renton summoned his courage for her．
With Titans, ZAFT, and AEUG, the
battle became a melee, and Renton
unleashed Nirvash's Seventh Swell via
the e Mitra drive from his grandfather
Axel． As Axel pressed Gekkostate to
leave, Renton chose to journey with
Eureka．

At Trinity City in the Pacific,
anti-alien forces gathered around King
Bial． Blue Fixer recovered a
mysterious space craft． Then the
Elders, who wiped out Jupiter's Io
colony, appeared． Burning with rage,
Toshiya, with Juli and Kirakenn,
completed God Sigma's combination．
With new power, King Bial departed to
fight aliens worldwide． Meanwhile,
the Elders allied with Gaizok and Vega
to destroy humanity．

The Dianna Counter targeted Fort
Severn, an autonomous city in North
America, as their return point from
the Moon． But this was the military's
reckless act, not Diana's will． Calis
hired the Freedom to counter them．
Iron Gear's crew and the Frosts' new
Federation forces appeared, and in the
melee, Diana, disguised as Kihal,
tried to swap with Kihal disguised as
Diana． The swap failed, but Fort
Severn was defended． The defeat only
accelerated the military's
recklessness．

At a trading post, Chiram attacks
Kei． The New Federation, ZAFT, AEUG,
aliens, King Beal, Shadow Angels,
Freeden, and Iron Gear all pile in,
causing chaos． Beating them back, the
group meets Capt． Reeven of Kaimera．
Scattered till now, the group finally
gathers as one．

Argama and Minerva, chasing
Gekkostate, are forced to fight them．
Renton's cry halts it． Their will to
fight gone, all join to meet the New
Federation troops that appear． A
mystery suit repels an alien - Kira's
Freedom, which once ended the last
war． After, Talia meets Holland and
offers a job instead of their help．

Duke Fried visited Trinity City．
Seeking his role in the alien war, he
met the S-１ alien Marin, an enemy
alien shunned by the crew． When alien
attack forces appeared, Toshiya and
Duke Fried fought but struggled
against the S-１ star Aldebaron's
subspace tactics． Quinshtain asked
Marin to sortie． Marin's comrades,
awakened by Duke Fried's words,
defeated Aldebaron with Baldios．s．

Talia's request for aid was denied by
the independent nation of Orb．
Kagari, its representative, was a
figurehead； real power had shifted to
the Seiran family, secretly allied
with the new Federation under the
guise of protecting Orb． Leaving,
they were caught between the new
Federation and Orb forces． Amuro from
Karaba and an unprecedented
performance from Sin saved them．
After the battle, Sin was consumed by
anger at Orb, but kind words to
soothed him． The Freedom crew split
off to watch Orb's moves．

The group opens a market． The Dianna
Counter shows up to plunder supplies．
Defending themselves, they repel
Chiram too． Kei notices a familiar-
moving Chiram machine． Dianna, as
Kiel, aches at the Counter's wayward
path． Chiram's plan to capture Kei
advances, led by his friend, Olson．

Awaiting them at Yapan's ceiling was
their former foe Adette． During a
festival to ease tensions, Asham
appeared, seeking Gain as his sworn
enemy． Gain beat him in a duel, but
Asham summoned Saint-Legan and Sibirsk
to attack in numbers． Roger,
appearing as Exodus' negotiator, saved
the day． The group pressed on toward
the legendary Yapan, continuing their
Exodus．

A refugee caravan was allowed aboard
Yapan's ceiling． Shouhei spotted
Katsuki and his group, who blamed the
Jin family for their exile and vented
their rage on him． Ignoring a
mysterious man's advice, Shouhei flew
into a rage and attacked the aliens in
Zambo Ace alone． As the Dushantens
joined the chaos, he learned the value
of comrades and defeated the enemy
together． Diana, seeing his stance,
revealed her true identity to Loran．

Gainer and the others tried to capture
a Skyfish at Holland's request． They
struggled against Kashel's Planetta,
and Gain's Gatchiko was destroyed．
However, Gainer's love confession to
Sara shook Kashel, and the party won．
Though Sara was angered by it, Gainer
earned Renton's respect． In the
chaos, the party formed an independent
guerrilla unit to work together across
factions．

Glory Star took Asakim's bait． After
repelling Chiram, Asakim's Shrowga
attacked them． They cornered Asakim
with the party, but it was his trap
all along． Toby was shot down, and
Asakim left, carving an undying fear
into them． Star ３, grieving another
lost comrade, decided to live as a
warrior, encouraged by those around
her and by Lowen．

Answering Asakim's call, Beater
Service rushes over． They repel
Chiram, but Za Heat is wounded．
Through the pain he also beats a
woman chasing Asakim． After, Asakim
leaves without saying much．

Kashel and Timp made a final gamble to
stop Yapan's ceiling． A mysterious
Overman said to serve the Sibet
president Kids Munto appeared, and the
battle raged． There, Kashel's scheme
revealed that Gawri killed Gainer's
parents． Gain forced Gainer to
fight． The party repelled the fallen
insects with Getter Robo, and the
Exodus succeeded． But Gainer, unable
to settle his heart, decided to begin
his own Exodus with his friends．

Using the seized lab, the Hyakki
Empire drives Kouji's group back．
Hydler gloats； Tekkoki demands a
rematch with rival Getter Robo．
Kouji's group storms the lab, and
with Tetsuya retakes it． Mazinger Z
and Great Mazinger crush the Empire．
They vow to wipe out the Hyakki
Empire hiding in Japan．

The ZAFT-led group stopped in Hong
Kong for supplies from Karaba．
Enjoying their free time, Shin and
Kamille met girls named Stella and
Fa． In battle with Phantom Pain, the
psycho Gundam's pilot was Fa． As
Kamille held back, Toga unhesitatingly
tried to finish off the disabled Fa．
Eiji stopped him, but was angered by
Toga's cold reasoning．

With Harry of the Dianna Counter, the
party attacked the New Federation's
Lohengrin Gate． Local cooperation and
Shin's efforts won, but Shin, lost in
rage, tried to fight beyond
necessity． Against the new Zelabia,
the uncoordinated Grand Knights
couldn't combine． They barely won,
but Eiji, distrusting Toga, left the
ship． Tetes, plotting to assassinate
Dianna, was catching on to her
identity as Kiel．

The party sought out Eiji, but his
resolve was firm． As the alien
alliance attacked, Toshiya and others
sortied, but Gaizok targeted the
townsfolk． Terar, moved by Toshiya's
courage, responded in kind． Against a
new Zelabia, the reunited Grand
Knights fought but were outmatched．
Eiji granted them a new power, the
Super Heavy Sword． He rejoiced in
their growth, yet his past wounds
ached．d．

The party fought Phantom Pain． With
Orb, allied to the New Federation,
joining, the Archangel and Freedom
appeared and called for a truce．
Knowing it would fail, Freedom
attacked the party to stop the
fighting． In the chaos with the
Ghingnham fleet, Haine fell． A
mysterious woman serving Asakim also
attacked． After the battle, the party
was baffled and angered by the
Archangel and Freedom's inscrutable
actions．

The party investigated a ruined lab．
Human augmentation had been studied
there, and its horror shook Rey．
Phantom Pain moved to recapture or
destroy the lab, the New Federation's
dark secret． In the fight, Shin
protected Stella and Kamille persuaded
Fa． But Fa sacrificed herself to
preserve her comrade Aul's memory．
The Freedom then shot down the
pursuing Athrun． With a bitter
victory, the party realized the threat
of leaving the Archangel and Freedom
unchecked．

Bright and the others met with Admiral
Edel at the Tampagunda base．
Meanwhile, the party learned of their
detachment's selfish actions and grew
angry． To overcome her fear of
Asakim, Star ３ answered his call．
Fighting Zine, Asakim's ally, she was
saved by Lt． Leben and her friends'
voices． Regaining her fighting
spirit, she defeated Zine． After
returning, she met Edel and asked Dr．
Jee of Kaemera to refit the Bargoal．

Star ３ sortied in the refitted
Bargoal at Toby's call． But waiting
was Land, Asakim's ally, and they
fought． In battle, Toby appeared and
shot Star ３． It was Asakim, mutated
by supernatural power． Her grief
peaked, transforming Gannery Carver
into something utterly alien． Asakim,
defeated by that power, rejoiced in
her awakening． Afterward, though
troubled by Land's words about being
deceived, she resolved to fight on
with the new Bargoal．

Heading to Gibraltar, the party tried
to meet the Radish, loaded with space
supplies． Alert to Phantom Pain,
Kamille and others went ahead, but the
enemy had already attacked．
Inexperienced Fa fought desperately
against cold Kamille． But it was Fa
who saved him from Jerid's new
machine． With the Z Gundam, Kamille
drove off Jerid and the others．
Afterward, Kamille found peace in Fa's
presence． Phantom Pain, having ousted
Neo, sent Commander Scirocco to the
front to lead directly．

At Gibraltar, Dianna and Durandal met,
but talks failed． Quattro then met
Durandal and learned of the
multi-world crisis． That night, at
Lacus Clyne's concert, Dianna was
abducted． Kamille, pursuing, faced
Paptimus Scirocco． In Phantom Pain's
base attack, Reccoa was shot down, and
a coup broke out in the Dianna
Counter． Revealing herself, Dianna
boarded Soleil to save Kiel, switching
places again．

Shinn and Rey's punishment for letting
Stella go was surprisingly light．
Kamille chided the arrogant Shinn． On
their own judgment, the party pursued
the Soleil to save Dianna． Amid
Dianna's and the New Federation's
attacks, the Freedom appeared and
offered help． But despite their
efforts, Dianna was taken to space．
Harry and Kiel accepted the
Archangel's offer and went to space
with them． As the party reeled, news
came of the New Federation's invasion
of Chiram．D

King Vial took in the amnesiac
refugees． Shouhei found Hamamoto,
Kyouko's comrade, among them． The
party intercepted the Gaizok attack．
Mid-battle, the refugees' section
exploded． They had been turned into
human bombs． Shouhei burned with
rage, but the enemy was too strong．
Earth's science couldn't defuse the
bombs． Hamamoto and the others left,
living in fear of detonation． Shouhei
and his friends had no words to give
them．

Duke Freed heard troubling rumors at
UN as he moved to join the party． The
party, burning with hatred for the
aliens, judged they couldn't win and
decided to contact the Dianna Counter
to gather intel on the Moon． The
Elder army attacked． God Sigma's new
weapons won, and they captured Terar．
But Toshiya let him go to stop the
human bombs． Against the party's
emotional call for total resistance,
Duke Freed left in silence．

The group faced the Archangel and
their former comrades． Talia, tasked
with shooting down the Archangel,
advised surrender, but with no common
ground, battle began． Shin targeted
the Freedom and fought with all his
might, finally shooting it down． This
prompted the Archangel and Iron Gear
forces to retreat． Then Banjo
appeared and revealed the truth： the
group and their friends had been used
by someone．

Dewey brands the Coralians mankind's
enemy, winning public support． The
group repels Coralians with the New
Federation, not knowing what they
are． The Coralians hit their limit
and die out． Meanwhile, Durandal
meets the "Black Charisma．"

Renton got word of Tiffa's whereabouts
from Dominic, a New Federation officer
he met in town． The Zonder Epta held
an eerie legend． Garrow and Renton
went ahead alone for recon, but were
caught with the Freeden by Katock's
scheme． Through Holland's desperate
charge, Jamil's resolve to save
Ruchil, and Katock's cooperation,
Garrow launched the DX． They rescued
Tiffa and Eureka, but Holland made
Renton realize his own helplessness．
Jamil and Holland, seeing themselves
in Katock, mourned his death．

Getter and Aquarion lost due to poor
teamwork． The Elements worked on
Fudou's harsh training, but were
baffled by it． Meanwhile, Gyukenki
challenged Getter． Despite his
doubts, Ryou faced him． In the
ensuing battle against the Shadow
Angels, Getter and Aquarion won with
new power． Fudou left cryptic words
behind． Shaya and Mimiji then set
course for Emarn．

To hide from various pursuers, the
group fled to an LFO excavation site
in South America． As Holland grew
frustrated, Eureka complained of
illness to Renton, but he had no room
to care． When enemies appeared,
Eureka went alone into the cave．
Renton followed and saw her merging
with the Scab． In response to his
shock and regret, the Nirvash
activated the Seventh Swell, letting
the group escape．

At Sarta base, the group met with
Kaimera and grew angry at their former
comrades' atrocities． They retrieved
a Vodarac monk from Chiram at
Kaimera's request, where Renton again
saw Holland's resolve and his own
weakness． Mail's father Cielo
appeared, but it was a trap set by
Asakim to damage Beatrice Service．
With Leben and Setsuko's help they
repelled the enemy, but Mail, learning
of her father's disappearance and her
body's secret, rejected the Heat．

Holland and the others met General
Edel and were impressed by his noble
character． Meanwhile, the Heat, with
Dr． Jie's help, unsealed Ganleon．
The Heat pursued Asakim on Setsuko's
intel, but without Ganleon, they were
powerless． After Beatrice Service
regained their bond with allies'
support, they unleashed Ganleon's
sleeping power and defeated Asakim．
As the group celebrated with General
Edel, Renton left the ship out of
self-loathing．

Fed up with Holland, Garrod's group
searches for Renton． In the city,
Renton befriends mercenaries the
Beams． The group joins Pala against
thugs； Ennil grows honest and helps
too． Renton leaves with the Beams．
Garrod's group waits for his return．

The group enjoyed freedom until Renton
returned． Roger appeared and gave
Kei a message from a mysterious
figure． It was his old friend Olson,
now a Chiram soldier, requesting
cooperation． But Robert, eager for
glory, tried to force-capture
Kei． Olson helped them escape,
but vengeful Asham and his men
appeared． They repelled them, but
Guroma reported the main force's dire
straits, forcing their return． Olson,
having disobeyed orders, was summoned
home, and pondered who was right,
himself or Kei．

Gekkostate separated from the main
force to settle things with their old
acquaintance Charles． Meanwhile,
Renton was offered adoption by the
Beams, but chose Eureka and left
them． Charles and Holland clashed．
Eureka and Renton reunited, and the
others who defeated the Over Devil
joined up． Despite Renton's cries,
the Beams vanished into the flames．
As word of Chiram's invasion reached
them, Asham revived the true Over
Devil．

At the Lunar Skullmoon base, spy
suspicions arose． Aphrodia ordered
Flick, the suspect, to hunt Marin．
Meanwhile, Marin was finally opening
up． Flick swore to fight with his old
friend and left Aldebaron, but
Aphrodia had anticipated this．
Trapped in a sealed space, Flick bared
his fangs out of self-preservation．
Knowing his true heart, Marin struck
him down for his friends． Following
his last words, she let Aphrodia, who
had failed to escape, go． Moved, Duke
Freed vowed to help the group．p．

Gainer finally met Cynthia, his game
rival, and they became friends．
Siberou Ironworks' president Kizz
Mount decided to personally crush Gain
and his allies, who had taken on
Urgusk's Exodus as an example． Kizz
cornered the group with Agat's crystal
and a massive army． Gainer and Sara
dodged the approaching Cynthia and
charged the crystal, but the Over
Devil revived． Its overwhelming power
forced the group to retreat． Defeated
by Cynthia, Gainer vowed to retrain
himself to awaken her．

The group helped Gainer train to
surpass himself． The decisive battle
against Siberou with the Over Devil
began． The Shadow Angels also
appeared to defeat it． As Reena's
vision showed, the two had been
ancient foes． Gainer succeeded in
destroying the Over Devil, but Cynthia
left． The group reunited with
Gekkostate, but news of Chiram's
invasion arrived． Meanwhile, Asham
revived the true Over Devil．

The group faced their former
comrades． Talia, tasked with shooting
down the Archangel, advised surrender,
but with no common ground, they
fought． Shin's fierce focus on the
Freedom overwhelmed Kira, and the
Freedom was finally shot down； the
Archangel also took damage from the
Minerva． Guided by Banjo's
appearance, the group withdrew and
learned from Olson that they and their
friends had been used． Talho then
revealed that Eureka was a Coralian．

The group headed to Trezore Institute
for Nirvash repairs． Dewey announced
the Coralian as humanity's enemy and
declared their annihilation． Learning
Dewey was awakening antibody
Coralians, they moved to stop it． In
that battle, the reborn Nirvash flew
with Renton and Eureka． But they were
forced to fight the antibody Coralian
that appeared and reluctantly
destroyed it． Meanwhile, Durandal met
with the mysterious Black Charisma．

Learning of the New Earth Federation's
time-space experiment from Athena, the
group planned to destroy it． But
guided by the Black Charisma, various
forces, including former comrades,
appeared． Amid the chaos, Bradman
decided to activate the time-space
vibration bomb to break the deadlock．
What should have been a tiny warp
instead caused Break the World-class
destruction． Then the Black Charisma
cast ominous words at the group．

The reunited group discussed what had
happened and learned that they had
misunderstood each other, moved by
someone's will． The Emann fleet
attacked to seize the singularity．
Shia declared her will to her sister
Manisha and protected them from
Chiram's forces． After repelling the
enemy, Chiram's leader invited them to
talks including Emann． Shia attended
as representative and declared action
